snippet.title: My game got a steam page - WISHLIST NOW!
snippet.description:
Wishlist to be notified of the launch:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3897790/Null_Anchor

Take to the skies of Null Anchor, a SCIFI hover RPG set in a sprawling human colony in a remote star system.
Race past hunking metal structures and industrial canyons, chasing freedom or fortune in a living, breathing city.

Every role, every risk, every score is your choice.
Be a pirate or scavenger; trader or smuggler; bounty hunter or outlaw. 
Upgrade and upgrade your vessel for a single purpose, scavenge wrecks, recover lost cargo, trade between depots, hunt police bounties.

In the future skies are the seas, but the ships have no anchors.

#nullanchor #indiedev #newrelease #gaming #scifi
